, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the team that Pa Amadou Gai is a member of” as his national team (Gambia) instead of his club (ASC HLM). Despite evidence on the Wikipedia page stating ASC HLM plays in the Senegal Premier League, the Planner concluded the country as Gambia, leading to the wrong answer instead of Senegal.
